svg.title: Three hundred and sixty dreams, one phone call
svg.text: Three hundred and sixty dreams, one phone call
Oleg's count: once a month for thirty years he woke remembering an old acquaintance in a dream.
thirty years, twelve dreams a year
the phone did not ring: written off, and not one of them can be named
the phone rang in the morning: remembered for life
The ledger of memory has an income column and no expense column.
A scheme of Oleg's rough figures, not data.
